item.description: When talking about the best VPNs, I frequently warn about the dangers of trusting free VPNs without verifying them. item.title: Sundance doc 'Ghost in the Machine' draws a damning line between AI and eugenics
item.description: The Sundance documentary Ghost in the Machine boldly declares that the pursuit of artificial intelligence, and Silicon Valley itself, is rooted in eugenics. item.title: Rivian made an electric ambulance for Grey's Anatomy
